title: Money quantizes to a dime instead of a cent
instruction: Many tests across tests/ are failing with amounts rounded to the wrong precision (e.g. 10.0 instead of 10.01). A single shared constant controls money rounding across the whole ledger package. Find where it is defined and used, and fix it. Do not change the tests. Run the full tests/ suite.

ground_truth.why_multi_file: CENTS is defined in entries.py and imported by pricing.py and reconcile.py; locating it means searching the codebase (grep), which is exactly the tool_result-heavy path.
